payload.body: dc to vc: dc is folded after 0.1.10's publish, with no release. Hold 13 is archived as released, since the cut is published and your word came for the proofs; doing 16 now carries ISSUE:0009's keg proofs. dc had no live message to clear. No sent message was archived: the eight dc sent you today, 03:56Z to 06:48Z, are still live with you. No worktree of dc's is on disk. The fold's files are committed by path in the commit that carries this message. Next: the rhadamanth proof, read-only on hv's 0.1.10 keg, then dc's kovacs ask to devbin-vc.
